entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected to the right department.
Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit customer service. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. It's not working.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Yes, the order number is VF-Pulse-88162. I just need to know if I can send it back.
Thank you. Just to be sure I'm routing this correctly, could you tell me a bit more about the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a fault. The thing is broken. It won't sync with the app anymore, and the screen freezes. It's defective. I don't have time to troubleshoot it, I just want to return it.
I understand. Thank you for clarifying. Let me just pull up your order details and check the return eligibility. One moment, please.
Alright, I have your order now. I can see you received the VeloBand Pulse 41 days ago. Let me check our policy...

Okay, yes. According to our system, all of our items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're at day 41, you are unfortunately outside that window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.
Great. So you're sending a return label?

That's correct. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 5 to 10 minutes. Once we receive the defective unit back at our warehouse, you'll get a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
